player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''YOYOY''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
cards: posted: Presence Of The Force (on Cantina)
notes: Posted 2 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (3)': Tatooine: Cantina, Twi'lek Advisor (the starting Interrupt) and Presence Of The Force (on the Cantina, the starting Effect); these count toward the 60. There is no Objective.
Two-sided generic cards dested the Dark pages: Tatooine: Cantina (Dark), Endor: Back Door (Dark) (posted 'Endor Back Door') and Dagobah (Dark) (the Special Edition Dark system; posted 'Dagobah').
Posted 'Presence Of The Force (on Cantina)' dested Presence Of The Force.
Total is 61 as published (not 60): the section counts posted are 3 + 2 + 20 + 36 interrupts.
The author says the deck is a fun deck, not built to win Worlds; no tournament finish is claimed.
